overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that the three case studies would always have distinct outcome bullet texts, so it did not add unique keys to the mapped outcome elements.
why_it_breaks: The `field` function renders `study.role` and `study.dates` inside a `<Badge>` and `<span>` respectively. When the three case studies share identical placeholder values (e.g., the same `[Outcome — what changed.]` text), React assigns the same default key to each child, triggering the "two children with the same key" warning six times. The agent overlooked that mapped children need explicit `key` props when the rendered text can be non-unique across iterations.
